title: Any working brain vat would be a surrogate body

statements.text: A vat that kept a brain working would have to be self-regulating and coupled to the brain’s intrinsic activity, and to mimic perception it would need real sensorimotor systems the brain controls. Any adequately functional vat would therefore be a surrogate body, an embodied agent in the world.

sources.quote: the null hypothesis is that the so-called vat would be no vat at all, but rather an embodied agent in the world
